Title: Head of operations
Description:

The Head of Operations (HO Operations) is responsible for the end-to-end operational performance of the subsidiary, covering spares distribution, technical support, training, Part 145 maintenance/repair activities, equipment repair, and contract management. Title: Information Security Program Manager
Description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Align ISMS controls with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability and supplier management.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

 CRISC or an equivalent risk management certification (advantageous)

 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification

**Key Competencies**

 Program and change management

 Risk-based thinking and sound technical judgement

 Stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority

 Analytical thinking and attention to detail

 Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Arabic is an advantage)

 Facilitation, coaching and training delivery

Pay: AED22,000.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Safety, housekeeping, and audit compliance.
* ERP data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* 12-15 years of experience in pouching department experience; out of which 3 to 4 yrs as pouching in charge or AM pouching
* Experience in operating and managing pouching machines for different pouch formats, such as three-side seal, centre seal, stand-up pouch, zipper pouch, flat bottom 3 D pouch , quad pouch and other applicable formats.
* Knowledge of flexible packaging materials, laminates, sealing characteristics, pouch specifications, and defect analysis.
* Experience in production planning, manpower management, troubleshooting, quality control, and productivity improvement.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, Excel, and root-cause analysis.

5. Required Competencies

* Strong production planning and execution skills.
* Leadership and manpower management.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Knowledge of pouching technology, process parameters and various pouching machine tools for all purposes.
* Focus on quality, productivity, waste reduction, and cost control.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional departments.
* Accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement mindset.

6. Authority and Accountability

* Allocate manpower and machines according to the approved production plan.
* Adjust machine settings within approved process specifications.
* Stop production when critical quality or safety issues are identified.
* Escalate material shortages, major breakdowns, quality deviations, and delivery risks.
* Recommend process improvements, training, and maintenance interventions.
* Accountable for departmental production performance, product quality, wastage, safety, and manpower utilization.

**Overall Accountability: To** ensure safe, efficient, cost-effective, and quality-compliant pouching operations while consistently achieving production and delivery targets.

Pay: AED7,500.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Job Title: Major Incident Manager**

**Location: New York, NY**

**Job Summary & Objectives**

* The Major Incident Manager leads the coordinated response to Severity 1 (Critical) and Severity 2 (Major) technology incidents affecting the firm’s lawyers, business professionals, clients, offices, or critical services.
* The role assumes operational command during a declared major incident and remains accountable for the incident lifecycle from declaration and role activation through service restoration, closure, post-incident review, and transition to Problem Management.
* The Major Incident Manager directs the response process but does not replace the Technical Lead, Service Owner, Communications Lead, Information Security, Legal, or engineering teams.
* The role establishes clear command and control, maintains urgency and disciplined decision-making, removes response barriers, ensures stakeholders receive accurate and timely information, and keeps participating teams focused on restoring business service.
* The position also advances the firm’s Major Incident Management program by maintaining standards, improving ServiceNow workflows, developing incident managers and responders, facilitating exercises, measuring performance, and converting lessons from incidents into permanent operational improvements.

**Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities**

**Major Incident Command**

* Serve as operational commander for declared Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, including technology outages with security, privacy, client-data, regulatory, contractual, or business-continuity implications.
* Validate business impact and urgency, declare the major incident, confirm or adjust severity, and document the basis for the decision.
* Assume ownership of all required incident roles until qualified individuals are assigned.
* Activate and chair the incident bridge or war room, establish operating discipline, and ensure the correct service owners, technical teams, vendors, and leadership representatives are engaged.
* Set response objectives, stakeholder-update cadence, decision points, escalation thresholds, action owners, and target times.
* Maintain separation between incident command and technical troubleshooting so technical responders can focus on diagnosis and restoration.
* Challenge unvalidated assumptions, redirect stalled activity, and escalate nonresponsive teams, vendor delays, missing authority, competing priorities, or resource constraints.
* Coordinate response across regions, time zones, technology pillars, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Manage incident-manager handoffs and relief during prolonged events while preserving continuity of command and an accurate chronology.
* Authorize severity changes and recommend stand-down or closure after technical restoration and business validation.
* Ensure emergency changes, workarounds, rollback decisions, and risk acceptances are properly authorized and recorded.

**Education Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Emergency Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**Preferred**

* ITIL 4 Foundation.
* ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver and Support.
* ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan and Improve.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or equivalent ServiceNow ITSM experience.
* Formal training in crisis management, incident command, Kepner-Tregoe, 5 Whys, or another structured investigation and decision-making method.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service management, technology operations, infrastructure, application support, service desk, or enterprise support.
* At least three years directly leading major incidents, crisis bridges, critical service-restoration efforts, or comparable high-pressure operational responses.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Knowledge Management, and service-level management.
* Hands-on experience using ServiceNow or an equivalent enterprise ITSM platform for incident command, task ownership, chronology, reporting, and audit evidence.
* Experience coordinating multiple technical disciplines during complex outages without assuming ownership of each technical workstream.
* Ability to translate technical conditions into clear business impact, risk, decisions, and actions for nontechnical leaders.
* Strong executive presence, judgment, composure, discretion, and communication skills.
* Ability to establish authority through role clarity, process discipline, and sound decision-making rather than organizational hierarchy.
* Strong written documentation skills, including incident summaries, executive updates, timelines, PIR inputs, procedures, and governance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and respond outside normal business hours.

**Preferred**

* Experience in an AmLaw firm, financial institution, global professional-services organization, or similarly regulated and client-sensitive environment.
* Experience coordinating security, privacy, client-data, or regulatory incidents with Information Security, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and external service providers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, network services, end-user computing, cloud platforms, virtual desktop, remote access, telephony, and legal-industry applications.
* Experience with globally distributed teams and follow-the-sun support.
* Experience designing or improving major-incident workflows, automation, dashboards, paging, and executive reporting.
* Experience planning and facilitating tabletop exercises and simulations.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Incident command and bridge facilitation.
* Business-impact and severity assessment.
* Structured escalation and decision management.
* Executive, attorney, client, and technical communications.
* ServiceNow ITSM and major-incident records.
* Evidence, chronology, and audit-quality documentation.
* Root-cause and contributing-factor analysis.
* Problem Management and corrective-action governance.
* Emergency Change and rollback coordination.

Title: Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Job Summary & Objectives**

The Major Incident Manager leads the coordinated response to Severity 1 (Critical) and Severity 2 (Major) technology incidents affecting the firm’s lawyers, business professionals, clients, offices, or critical services. The role assumes operational command during a declared major incident and remains accountable for the incident lifecycle from declaration and role activation through service restoration, closure, post-incident review, and transition to Problem Management.

The Major Incident Manager directs the response process but does not replace the Technical Lead, Service Owner, Communications Lead, Information Security, Legal, or engineering teams. The role establishes clear command and control, maintains urgency and disciplined decision-making, removes response barriers, ensures stakeholders receive accurate and timely information, and keeps participating teams focused on restoring business service.

The position also advances the firm’s Major Incident Management program by maintaining standards, improving ServiceNow workflows, developing incident managers and responders, facilitating exercises, measuring performance, and converting lessons from incidents into permanent operational improvements.

**Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities**

**Major Incident Command**

* Serve as operational commander for declared Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, including technology outages with security, privacy, client-data, regulatory, contractual, or business-continuity implications.
* Validate business impact and urgency, declare the major incident, confirm or adjust severity, and document the basis for the decision.
* Assume ownership of all required incident roles until qualified individuals are assigned.
* Activate and chair the incident bridge or war room, establish operating discipline, and ensure the correct service owners, technical teams, vendors, and leadership representatives are engaged.
* Set response objectives, stakeholder-update cadence, decision points, escalation thresholds, action owners, and target times.
* Maintain separation between incident command and technical troubleshooting so technical responders can focus on diagnosis and restoration.
* Challenge unvalidated assumptions, redirect stalled activity, and escalate nonresponsive teams, vendor delays, missing authority, competing priorities, or resource constraints.
* Coordinate response across regions, time zones, technology pillars, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Manage incident-manager handoffs and relief during prolonged events while preserving continuity of command and an accurate chronology.
* Authorize severity changes and recommend stand-down or closure after technical restoration and business validation.
* Ensure emergency changes, workarounds, rollback decisions, and risk acceptances are properly authorized and recorded.

**Communication & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Direct the Communications Lead in preparing clear, concise, fact-based incident notifications for IT responders, business stakeholders, firm leadership, and other approved audiences.
* Confirm affected services, user and client impact, available workaround, response ownership, current actions, risks, and the expected next update before communications are released.
* Maintain the required communication cadence, including status, material changes, service restoration, and closure notices.
* Provide concise executive briefings that distinguish confirmed facts, working hypotheses, unknowns, decisions required, and business risk.
* Coordinate with Information Security, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and firm leadership when an incident may involve confidential information, client data, regulatory notification, contractual commitments, or reputational exposure.
* Ensure external, client, insurer, regulator, or law-enforcement communications follow required approval paths.
* Protect confidentiality and legal privilege by limiting sensitive incident information to approved channels and audiences.

**Documentation, Closure & Post-Incident Review**

* Ensure the major incident record is complete and maintained as the authoritative record in ServiceNow.
* Ensure the Scribe captures actions, decisions, timestamps, communications, owners, escalation attempts, changes, workarounds, and restoration evidence in real time.
* Confirm technical restoration with the Technical Lead and validate business service restoration with the Service Owner before closing the incident.
* Ensure final communications accurately describe service status, remaining risk, monitoring requirements, and any continuing workaround.
* Remain accountable for completion of the Post-Incident Review and ensure the chronology, decisions, evidence, communication history, and performance data are available for review.
* Partner with the Problem Manager to identify root cause, contributing factors, control failures, known errors, and corrective actions.
* Ensure remediation items have named owners, priorities, target dates, and traceable ServiceNow records.
* Escalate overdue or ineffective remediation and report repeat incidents, systemic risks, and unresolved corrective actions to leadership.
* Update procedures, training, response templates, contact rosters, and knowledge content based on approved lessons learned.

**Process Ownership & Operational Readiness**

* Maintain the Major Incident Management lifecycle, operating procedures, decision authority, RACI, response checklists, escalation matrices, communication templates, contact rosters, and bridge information.
* Partner with Global Support Operations and the ServiceNow platform team to improve workflows, automation, notifications, dashboards, paging, and reporting.
* Maintain a qualified Incident Manager and Deputy Incident Manager roster with appropriate global and after-hours coverage.
* Develop and deliver role-based training for Incident Managers, Service Desk leaders, regional support leaders, Communications Leads, Scribes, and technical responders.
* Plan and facilitate tabletop exercises, simulations, and incident-response drills; assess performance and track readiness improvements to completion.
* Coordinate with Security Incident Response, Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, Emergency Change, Problem Management, and Vendor Management processes.
* Support governance reviews and recommend changes to incident criteria, authority, coverage, service levels, and escalation expectations.
* Prepare leadership reporting on major incident performance, recurring failure patterns, response risks, and remediation status.

**Measures of Success**

* Incident Manager engaged within 5 minutes of a validated request.
* Qualifying major incident declared within 10 minutes.
* Required roles assigned and bridge activated within 5 minutes of declaration.
* Initial stakeholder communication delivered within 15 minutes for Severity 1 and 30 minutes for Severity 2 incidents.
* Compliance with the approved stakeholder-update cadence.
* Mean time to acknowledge, declare, mobilize, mitigate, restore, and close.
* Percentage of incidents with a complete timeline and decision log.
* Percentage of Post-Incident Reviews and corrective actions completed within approved targets.
* Reduction in repeat incidents and recurrence associated with previously identified control gaps.
* Incident Manager roster readiness, training completion, and exercise performance.
* Stakeholder assessment of communication clarity, accuracy, timeliness, and usefulness.

**Education**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Emergency Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**Preferred**

* ITIL 4 Foundation.
* ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver and Support.
* ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan and Improve.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or equivalent ServiceNow ITSM experience.
* Formal training in crisis management, incident command, Kepner-Tregoe, 5 Whys, or another structured investigation and decision-making method.

**Skills & Experience**

**Required**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service management, technology operations, infrastructure, application support, service desk, or enterprise support.
* At least three years directly leading major incidents, crisis bridges, critical service-restoration efforts, or comparable high-pressure operational responses.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Knowledge Management, and service-level management.
* Hands-on experience using ServiceNow or an equivalent enterprise ITSM platform for incident command, task ownership, chronology, reporting, and audit evidence.
* Experience coordinating multiple technical disciplines during complex outages without assuming ownership of each technical workstream.
* Ability to translate technical conditions into clear business impact, risk, decisions, and actions for nontechnical leaders.
* Strong executive presence, judgment, composure, discretion, and communication skills.
* Ability to establish authority through role clarity, process discipline, and sound decision-making rather than organizational hierarchy.
* Strong written documentation skills, including incident summaries, executive updates, timelines, PIR inputs, procedures, and governance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and respond outside normal business hours.

**Preferred**

* Experience in an AmLaw firm, financial institution, global professional-services organization, or similarly regulated and client-sensitive environment.
* Experience coordinating security, privacy, client-data, or regulatory incidents with Information Security, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and external service providers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, network services, end-user computing, cloud platforms, virtual desktop, remote access, telephony, and legal-industry applications.
* Experience with globally distributed teams and follow-the-sun support.
* Experience designing or improving major-incident workflows, automation, dashboards, paging, and executive reporting.
* Experience planning and facilitating tabletop exercises and simulations.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Incident command and bridge facilitation.
* Business-impact and severity assessment.
* Structured escalation and decision management.
* Executive, attorney, client, and technical communications.
* ServiceNow ITSM and major-incident records.
* Evidence, chronology, and audit-quality documentation.
* Root-cause and contributing-factor analysis.
* Problem Management and corrective-action governance.
* Emergency Change and rollback coordination.
* Information-security, privacy, confidentiality, and business-continuity awareness.
* Vendor escalation and support-entitlement management.
* Global coverage, handoffs, and on-call operations.
* Calm leadership during incomplete, rapidly changing, and high-risk situations.

**Role Authority & Scope Boundary**

*The Major Incident Manager owns the incident-management process and operational command of the response. Technical Leads and Service Owners remain responsible for technical diagnosis, corrective actions, and service validation. The Communications Lead owns message preparation and distribution through approved channels. The Problem Manager facilitates root-cause review and tracks long-term remediation. The Major Incident Manager remains accountable for coordinated execution, escalation, closure, and completion of the post-incident process.*

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily office-based or hybrid work in accordance with firm policy.
* Regular after-hours, weekend, and holiday availability as part of an on-call rotation.
* Periods of sustained concentration and extended working hours during Severity 1 or prolonged Severity 2 incidents.
* Occasional travel to firm offices, response exercises, or operational-readiness sessions.
* Sedentary work consistent with a professional office role.

Title: Senior Project Manager – Cybersecurity

Title: Senior Director, Information Technology
Description:

The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 14-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. In addition to progressive IT leadership experience, the ideal candidate will be a clear communicator, highly collaborative, and able to step into an established environment quickly, combining sound strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to day-to-day operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

***Technology Leadership & Execution***

* Serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and leadership team, providing clear, concise updates and recommendations.
* Ensures technology priorities remain aligned with organizational goals and carries forward in-flight initiatives to agreed milestones.
* Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.
* Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.

***AI Implementation & Adoption***

* Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.

**Your experience includes:**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
* Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.

* Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.
* Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.
* Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.

**You’re often described as:**

* A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions
* Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines
* A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover
* A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments

**Working Conditions:**

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Incident Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is hybrid, requires 3 days onsite. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
  
Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Incident Manager to support a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer. This role serves as the primary owner of the enterprise incident management lifecycle, ensuring rapid detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review of IT incidents across a geographically distributed, 24x7 hybrid on-premises and cloud environment spanning AWS commercial and GovCloud, Microsoft 365, Azure Government, and enterprise network and application platforms.
  
  
The Incident Manager operates within a mature ITIL 4-aligned IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and works in close coordination with the enterprise NOC, multi-tier Service Desk, network engineering, infrastructure, and platform operations teams to ensure that all incidents are managed to resolution within established service level objectives. This individual plays a central role in driving service restoration, minimizing business impact, and contributing to the program's continual service improvement objectives through trend analysis, problem identification, and post-incident learning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and operationally experienced ITSM professional with a strong background in enterprise incident management, ITIL-based service management practices, and federal IT operations environments. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability 24x7 operational setting and possess the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse technical teams and Government stakeholders under time-critical conditions.
  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be primarily performed at SBA Headquarters and/or approved remote/telework locations.
  
  
The Incident Manager is responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end enterprise incident management lifecycle in accordance with ITIL 4 best practices and SBA OCIO service management requirements. This individual ensures that all incidents—from Tier 1 Service Desk tickets through Priority 1 critical enterprise outages—are accurately classified, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs). The Incident Manager serves as the central coordination hub during major incidents, driving technical bridge calls, managing stakeholder communications, and ensuring timely service restoration. This role also contributes to problem management, change management support, knowledge management, and continual service improvement activities.
  
  
**Incident Lifecycle Management**
**Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Own and manage the full enterprise incident management lifecycle from initial detection and logging through triage, categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, resolution, and formal closure in the Government's ITSM platform.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately classified by priority (P1–P4) in accordance with established impact and urgency criteria, and that appropriate response and resolution timelines are applied and monitored in real time.
* Monitor the active incident queue continuously, identifying aging incidents, escalation triggers, SLA breach risks, and stalled assignments, and taking proactive action to ensure forward progress on all open incidents.
* Coordinate and drive the timely assignment of incidents to the appropriate Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 technical resources based on incident category, complexity, and required expertise.
* Ensure incidents are escalated promptly and appropriately—both functionally across technical teams and hierarchically to program leadership and Government stakeholders—when SLA thresholds, scope, or business impact warrant escalation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely incident records in the ITSM platform throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring all actions, decisions, workarounds, and resolutions are thoroughly documented.

**Major Incident Management**

* Serve as the primary coordinator and decision-maker for all Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) major incidents, activating and leading technical bridge calls, war rooms, and cross-functional response teams to drive rapid service restoration.
* Ensure P1 critical incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and that service restoration is achieved within 4 hours in accordance with program service level objectives, meeting the Government's target of at least 90% of P1 incidents restored within the 4-hour SLA.
* Maintain clear, accurate, and timely stakeholder communications throughout major incident events, including initial notifications, status updates at defined intervals, and formal incident closure notifications to the COR and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the NOC, Service Desk Manager, technical leads, and program leadership to ensure all required resources are engaged, barriers to resolution are removed, and escalation paths are followed during major incidents.
* Lead or facilitate formal post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all P1 and significant P2 incidents, ensuring root cause analysis findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and lessons learned are thoroughly documented and tracked to completion.

**Problem Management Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager or Service Management Lead to ensure incidents exhibiting patterns of recurrence or systemic root causes are formally transitioned into the problem management process.
* Contribute incident trend data, recurring issue patterns, and workaround documentation to support problem record creation, root cause investigation, and known error documentation.
* Track and monitor the implementation of permanent fixes and corrective actions arising from problem management activities, ensuring incident recurrence rates are measurably reduced over time.

**Change Management Support**

* Coordinate with the change management process to identify incidents resulting from unauthorized changes or failed changes, ensuring accurate linkage between incident records and associated change records in the ITSM platform.
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as needed, providing incident trend data and operational risk inputs to support change impact assessment and scheduling decisions.

**ITSM Platform Administration & Reporting**

* Administer and maintain incident management workflows, categorization schemas, assignment group structures, escalation rules, and SLA configurations within the Government's ITSM platform (ServiceNow or equivalent) to ensure accurate and efficient incident processing.
* Develop, maintain, and deliver recurring incident management performance reports and dashboards, including metrics on incident volumes, SLA compliance rates, mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), first-contact resolution rates, escalation rates, and incident trends by category and priority.
* Contribute incident management metrics and performance data to Sprint Review Reports, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, and the service-level/ITSM metrics dashboard submitted to the Government by the 5th business day of each month.
* Analyze incident data to identify trends, high-volume categories, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to program leadership and the Service Management Lead.

**Knowledge Management**

* Oversee the development, review, and maintenance of incident-related knowledge base articles, resolution guides, troubleshooting procedures, and known error workarounds in the Government's ITSM knowledge management system.
* Ensure Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate, and actionable knowledge base content to support first-contact resolution objectives, targeting at least 70% of eligible tickets resolved at Tier 1.
* Promote a knowledge-sharing culture across the NOC and Service Desk, ensuring resolution documentation is captured at ticket closure and that institutional knowledge is preserved throughout personnel transitions.

**Agile Delivery Integration**

* Participate in Sprint ceremonies as required, including Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives, contributing incident management workstream priorities, improvement backlog items, and operational performance data to the Sprint cadence.
* Maintain and manage incident management-related backlog items in the Government's Agile/ITSM tooling, ensuring items are accurately prioritized, estimated, and tracked to completion each Sprint.
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities for inclusion in the program backlog, driving measurable enhancements to incident management efficiency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure all incident management activities comply with applicable Federal security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, SBA IT and cybersecurity policies, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Ensure suspected or confirmed security incidents are promptly identified, escalated, and reported in accordance with SBA incident response procedures and applicable Federal reporting requirements.
* Support the application of least-privilege, separation-of-duties, and Zero Trust principles within incident management workflows and access control practices.

**Required**
**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT service management, with at least 3 years of dedicated experience in an Incident Manager, Major Incident Manager, or equivalent ITSM leadership role in an enterprise federal IT environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full incident lifecycle—including P1 major incident coordination—in a 24x7 enterprise IT operations environment of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience with ITIL-based ITSM practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management.
* Hands-on experience administering and managing incidents within an enterprise ITSM platform, preferably ServiceNow.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and all required IT access authorizations prior to performing work requiring such access.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience supporting federal civilian agency IT operations programs.
* Experience supporting incident management within hybrid on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Microsoft Azure/365.
* Experience working within an Agile IT operations delivery model, integrating ITSM processes with Sprint-based planning and prioritization.

**Required Skills And Competencies**

* Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely under time-critical conditions to diverse audiences including technical teams, program leadership, and senior Government stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional technical teams during high-pressure major incident events, driving rapid diagnosis and service restoration without direct authority over all participants.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL 4 incident management principles and practices, including incident classification, prioritization, escalation, SLA management, major incident management, and post-incident review processes.
* Hands-on proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms, particularly ServiceNow, including incident workflow configuration, queue management, SLA monitoring, escalation rule management, and reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify incident trends, recurring patterns, and systemic issues from ITSM data and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining incident management performance dashboards and metrics reports, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance rates, first-contact resolution rates, and incident volume trends.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain a high-quality knowledge base, ensuring Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate resolution guidance.

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.
  
  
**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**
**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: Associate Director, Clinical Services - Remote
Description:
***We Are Inspired to Serve. Join us!***
----------------------------------------

The Associate Director, Clinical Services position is the central office resource for community personnel related to clinical operations in both Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living. In addition, this position will develop, facilitate, implement, and maintain the healthcare to include, operation, clinical, regulatory, and financial standards for the assigned region. The Associate Director, Clinical Services fosters a culture of delivering high quality resident care, operational efficiency, staff development and regulatory compliance.  
  
The Associate Director, Clinical Services will collaborate and form strong partnerships with the central office team, and community leadership, in various aspects of healthcare operations.

**This position requires 50% travel to assigned communities within Covenant Living portfolio. Position can work remotely from home base when not traveling.**

***MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:***

* Collaborate with the Associate Vice President of Healthcare Regulation, Compliance, and Quality in the development, review, and implementation of regulatory, compliance, and quality programs.
* Reviewing and assisting in the development of guidelines to adhere to regulatory directives.
* Monitoring, auditing, and validating practices, identifying problems, and working with healthcare personnel to develop and implement plans to correct inconsistencies and revise standardized practices.
* Ensuring that all required documentation, including care/service plans and assessments are completed in a timely manner, and that assessments/service plans are compliant with federal and state regulations.

**2. Strategic Planning:**

* Developing and implementing clinical programs and initiatives to improve patient care and outcomes.

**3. Collaboration and Communication:**

* Supporting SNF and AL sales and outreach goals, in collaboration with outside marketing support.

**4. Resource Management:**

In partnership with community leadership and central office staff, review survey reports, community plans of correction prior to submission, and collaborate on any IDR possibilities.**

Title: Sr. Manager of Construction (Southeast Region), SE AMER Construction
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
The Sr. Manager of Construction is a strategically significant role on the Data Center Construction team dedicated to leading, mentoring, and coaching our team of skilled Construction Managers and other managers of construction. You will lead a diverse and creative team solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. You will manage a fast-moving, intelligent team of professionals and the regional construction program delivering data center capacity to support Amazon’s growth in the United States and other potential sites in North America.  
  
Our Data Center Construction team owns and drives the construction life cycle from constructability, proposal development, bid analysis, award, to managing the onsite construction work.  
  
The manager will be expected to dive deep and know construction management; inspire and think big about the construction management program; and support, grow, and nurture the team delivering efficient and sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems to our Customers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Sr. Manager of Construction will be responsible for:  
  

* Hire and develop new Construction Managers. Coach, mentor, and lead a large Construction Management team across multiple states.
* Strategic and tactical management of construction capacity delivery within their regions.
* Communicate and provide guidance to Finance during the development and execution of capital budgets.
* Coordinate with various teams supporting the data center development and launch.
* Develop and manage metrics quantifying performance within their regions.
* Coordinate with Business Development on land and facility acquisition.
* Manage the safety, cost, and quality of the data center deliverable.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning may begin reviewing operational metrics and safety reports with your leadership team, identifying areas that need attention and celebrating recent wins. Mid-day, you could be partnering with cross-functional peers to plan capacity for upcoming infrastructure needs or coaching one of your managers through a complex staffing challenge. You will regularly evaluate and refine generative artificial intelligence tools and automation opportunities to improve how your teams work. By afternoon, you might be preparing a strategic narrative for senior leadership or facilitating a talent review to ensure the right people are growing into the right roles.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in construction management or construction program management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) plants
* 15+ years of progressive experience in construction and project execution, including 5+ years managing managers (second-line leadership of Area/Senior Construction Managers or equivalent people leaders).
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning, and construction), mission-critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds at a program/portfolio scale spanning concurrent sites.
* Experience setting direction, standards, and execution strategy for general contractor and vendor management (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) across a multi-site portfolio, including master service agreements and regional GC/vendor capacity planning.
* Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations — feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units — sufficient to govern design and constructability decisions across a region, not a single build.
* 15+ years of relevant experience constructing and managing complex MEP systems, including large-scale power distribution/generation gear and cooling systems in mission-critical environments, with demonstrated ownership of multi-site execution outcomes.
* Experience owning org-level goals and operating mechanisms; headcount planning, span-of-control and org design, hiring and talent development, budget, and schedule/quality/safety performance across a cluster or multiple clusters.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders (Director/VP level, cross-functional partners such as engineering, supply chain, operations, and finance) and driving strategic initiatives that create measurable business impact for the larger construction organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or an equivalent engineering science degree + 15 years relevant overall experience, or 20+ years relevant overall experience in construction management in lieu of a degree — including multi-site leadership experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in multiple finance and accounting roles, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* Experience building and scaling construction organizations — standing up new regions/clusters, defining the operating model, and developing a bench of people leaders (succession planning for L6/Area Manager roles).
* Track record of strategic, org-wide impact: establishing standards, playbooks, or mechanisms adopted across regions that measurably improved delivery at scale.
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, and OSHA, and experience governing code/regulatory compliance across jurisdictions in multiple states.
* Experience in program/portfolio management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure at a multi-region scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and change — reorganizations, rapid scaling, and shifting business priorities across a distributed, multi-site team.

Description:
