433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.
* Certification professionnelle PMP (Project Management Professional), PMI-RMP (PMI Risk Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), CCP (Certified Cost Professional), Lean Six Sigma ou certification équivalente

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Leadership transversal et capacité à influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en résolution structurée de problèmes et solide jugement professionnel.
* Sens des responsabilités, rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Capacité à remettre en question de façon constructive, à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à escalader les enjeux avec clarté lorsque nécessaire.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication avec la haute direction et capacité à présenter des analyses et recommandations fondées sur les données.
* Mentalité d’amélioration continue et engagement envers l’apprentissage organisationnel et le partage des meilleures pratiques.

Title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.

**What you will do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What you will bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's in it for you**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.

***\*Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.***

Title: Tech Lead - Conversational AI & Driver Automation
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi-channel chatbots, and a production-grade multi-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. + Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers — driving technical quality, delivery velocity, and engineering culture.
+ Own sprint planning, technical scope definition, and delivery commitments for the conversational AI and driver automation domain.
+ Conduct design reviews, define coding standards, and maintain engineering quality across IVR, chatbot, and agentic system codebases.
+ Act as the primary technical interface between Engineering, Product, and Operations for all driver-facing automation initiatives.
+ Partner with the R&D Director to shape the team's technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI capabilities, and surface the next high-leverage bets.

* IVR & Voice Automation

+ Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice-to-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation-to-human ratios.

* Conversational AI & Chatbots

+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real-time chat channels.
+ Own the four-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.

* Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver-facing apps via secure, event-driven patterns.
* Agentic AI & SOP Automation

+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs-as-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine-readable policies executed by the multi-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.

* AWS Infrastructure & MLOps

+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.
+ Define observability standards — per-agent-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.
+ Lead capacity and cost planning as interaction volumes scale across driver and operations channels.

* R&D & Innovation

+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof-of-concept with clear go/no-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team-wide use

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end-to-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.
* Ownership without ego: defines problems, architects solutions, ships results — accountable for outcomes across the full platform, not just assigned tickets.
* Operational intelligence: understands the business context of driver support, logistics operations, and the real cost of failure in real-time systems.
* Senior communicator: articulates trade-offs (agent reliability vs. automation rate, cost vs. latency) clearly to non-engineers and influences roadmap decisions through clarity of thought.
* Structured under ambiguity: brings process and rigor to fast-moving R&D environments where requirements evolve alongside the build.
* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.
* Collaborative and direct: raises architectural risks early, pushes back on under-specified requirements, and surfaces trade-offs before they become delivery blockers.

**Conversational AI & LLMs (Core)**

* Deep experience with AWS Bedrock — Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and model invocation; strong preference for Claude Sonnet/Opus via Bedrock.
* Multi-agent system design: orchestration patterns, agents-as-tools, inter-agent handoffs, context propagation, and failure isolation.
* Prompt engineering: system prompt design, structured output, tool-use, multi-turn reasoning, eval-driven iteration, and red-teaming for safety.
* Structured rules engines: condition/operator/value schemas for deterministic, noninterpretive decision logic — mandatory in production agentic systems.
* RAG pipelines: embedding models, vector databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), hybrid retrieval, and knowledge base tuning.

**IVR & Voice**

* IVR architecture: call flow design, intent/slot management, DTMF handling, escalationto-human routing, and SLA monitoring.
* Experience with STT/TTS pipelines or voice bot platforms is a strong plus.

**AWS Services (Core)**

* Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch — event-driven and serverless architectures.
* AWS Bedrock Agents: agent creation, alias management, tool action group configuration, and Guardrail policy management.
* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.
* CI/CD for AI services: prompt versioning, agent config deployment pipelines, automated evals, and rollback gates.

**Backend & Engineering**

* Python — async, OOP, clean code; REST API design with FastAPI or Flask.
* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
* Salesforce integration (APIs, events, data sync) is a strong plus.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**

* Knowledge of logistics, food delivery, or real-time operations domains.
* Arabic language NLP or experience building for Arabic-speaking markets.
* Familiarity with open-weight model inference (Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace Transformers).
* Exposure to multi-modal AI or voice-first interaction design.

Title: Senior Manager, Hotel Talent Solutions
Description:
This role will lead a defined portfolio of enterprise Hotel Talent Solutions, with close partnership with IHG’s largest hotel market in the AMER region. Reporting to the UK-based Head of Hotel Talent Solutions, the role turns hotel growth, workforce and guest[1]service priorities into evidence-led, scalable talent products that strengthen General Manager and critical-role pipelines, leadership capability and hotel performance culture. A major responsibility is leading the Hotel Talent contribution to the launch and sustained adoption of Time to SHINE, IHG’s new service behavior program, in partnership with Hotel Operations, Brand, Learning and Talent Enablement. **Required contribution in the future model**

Independently own complex hotel talent products and SHINE activation workstreams from diagnosis and design through piloting, readiness, deployment support and measurable sustainment. This is a senior product-design and change role—not a regional talent program coordinator or the owner of hotel operations, training curriculum or recruitment delivery.

**Your day to day**

* Translate the Hotel Talent Solutions roadmap into business outcomes for GM and critical-role pipelines, hotel performance culture, SHINE activation and leadership capability. Link priorities to guest experience, colleague retention, operating productivity, hotel growth and owner value.
* Bring a differentiated US and military-hotel perspective to global product decisions, recognizing IHG-employed hotel colleagues and distinct managed/franchised operating models. Make evidence-led recommendations

on scale, affordability, workforce needs and controlled localization.

**Diagnosis & Evidence-led Advisory**

* Lead discovery with Hotel Operations, GMs, hotel HR, Enablement and colleagues. Diagnose service and performance constraints using guest feedback, observed behaviors, colleague insight, retention, leadership and ipeline measures—not assumptions that training alone solves the problem.
* Translate growth in traditional and military hotels into evidence-led capability and leadership requirements. Test existing products and SHINE standards before recommending new design or a justified market adaptation.

**Product, Process & Experience Design**

* Own assigned global hotel products spanning GM/critical-role success

profiles, assessment, succession, careers, Journey to GM/J2 and high[1]performance culture. Build products for use by GMs, hotel HR and operations, aligning with Learning, TA, Reward and Inclusion.

Use commercial storytelling and constructive challenge to secure decisions and remove adoption barriers.

Title: Director, HR Applications Development
Description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a visionary Director of HR Applications Engineering to lead the technology platforms that power Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast’s global people processes and employee experience. This leader will own the continued operation and modernization of our HR application ecosystem — spanning SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, workforce management, and our global payroll platforms, along with integrations to Anaplan and other enterprise and IT systems — while driving a fundamental shift in how the team delivers new capability: building custom microservices, APIs, and AI-powered automation around and on top of these systems, rather than relying solely on native configuration.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical ownership of enterprise HR platforms together with hands-on engineering leadership — designing cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions that extend what our SaaS platforms can do natively. This leader will co-architect the HR application portfolio to achieve the people and business goals of the HR function, serving as HR's technical counterpart and accountable for how business requirements are architected, built, integrated, run, and measured. This is a dual mandate: keep a stable, compliant, well-governed HR technology foundation running, while leading the team's transformation into a modern product-engineering organization that builds intelligent, automated employee experiences. This team treats Hasbro's internal HR platforms with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software — with real users, clear success measures, and a roadmap driven by business value. In this role, you will shape how that team builds technology that improves the everyday work experience of employees across Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast.

**Location and Work Arrangement**

This role is based at our Boston, Massachusetts office and follows a hybrid schedule designed to support in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work onsite on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or onsite on Mondays and Fridays.

**What You'll Do**

* In partnership with HR Business stakeholders, define and execute against an aligned global HR applications strategy and roadmap that balances continued investment in core SaaS platforms (SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, workforce management, payroll systems, and related HR technology) with a growing portfolio of custom-built microservices, APIs, and AI-driven capabilities.
* Lead the team's evolution from a configuration-centric operating model to a product-engineering model, in which new capability is increasingly delivered through code, integration, and automation rather than native application customization alone.
* Own, jointly with HR Systems, a standing build-versus-buy-versus-configure framework for every significant capability request — weighing native SaaS functionality, vendor or partner solutions, and custom engineering against cost, time-to-value, supportability, security, and long-term ownership — and make these decisions transparent to HR and technology stakeholders.
* Architect and oversee the design, build, and integration of microservices and APIs that extend SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, workforce management, payroll, and related HR platforms, and connect them to other business applications, including financial planning (Anaplan) and the broader IT ecosystem — delivering capabilities the underlying SaaS products cannot provide natively.
* Drive the responsible design and delivery of AI and GenAI-powered capabilities — intelligent HR assistants and copilots, automated document generation, onboarding/offboarding workflow automation, and people analytics — built as reusable, well-governed services rather than one-off point solutions.
* Establish engineering standards, architecture patterns, and reusable frameworks (leveraging platforms such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)) for integration, automation, and AI capability delivery across the HR technology ecosystem.
* Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of product managers, solutions engineers, software engineers, and application professionals; actively reskill and evolve a team historically focused on SaaS configuration toward product engineering, API development, and AI-enabled automation.
* Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement through agile delivery, DevSecOps practices, and modern software engineering discipline.
* Partner with HR Systems, HR, Payroll, Total Rewards, Talent, Learning, Finance, Legal, and Information Security leaders to translate business needs into a prioritized, engineering-driven product roadmap.
* Partner with the HR Systems team and HR stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technical specifications, architecture, and delivery plans for the applications and engineering teams.
* Institutionalize product lifecycle discipline — discovery, user stories with acceptance criteria, backlog management, value-based prioritization, release planning, and delivery milestones — using Agile practices across both platform and custom engineering work.
* Define success metrics jointly with HR Systems for every product and major capability (e.g., adoption, employee and manager experience, process cycle time, data quality, cost-to-serve); monitor adoption after launch, report measured business impact to stakeholders, and use results to guide further investment or retirement.
* Establish governance that balances innovation, operational stability, regulatory requirements, and the needs of employees, managers, and HR/payroll teams.
* Continue to lead core platform operations — releases, upgrades, integrations, incident management, and production support — keeping the full HR Systems portfolio reliable while the team shifts toward new engineering work.
* Lead complex initiatives spanning platform modernization, new capability delivery, and process transformation, with defined success metrics established up front and measured after delivery.
* Strengthen workforce data quality, governance, and integration across HR, recruiting, payroll, time, benefits, and finance platforms (including Anaplan), ensuring new microservices and AI capabilities are built with privacy, security, and audit requirements embedded by design.
* Ensure compliance with global data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements through effective access controls, segregation of duties, and technology risk management.
* Manage relationships with SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, workforce management and payroll providers, cloud platforms, and systems-integration/managed-services partners, holding them accountable for quality, security, innovation, and business outcomes.
* Optimize contracts, licensing, and the broader application portfolio to reduce duplication, control cost, and maximize return on technology investment.
* Serve as a visible leader for HR technology transformation, building alignment among HR executives, HR Systems, technology teams, and business partners around a more engineering-driven way of working, and clearly communicating strategy, priorities, delivery progress, risk, and outcomes to stakeholders at every level.
* Clearly communicate strategy, priorities, delivery progress, risk, and outcomes to stakeholders at every level.

**What You'll Bring**

* Proven leadership of global HR technology platforms, with demonstrated success also leading software or applications-engineering teams — not configuration-only teams.
* Hands-on familiarity with building microservices, APIs, and integrations (cloud-native architectures, event-driven design, middleware) and demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation (Robotic Process Automation (RPA), workflow automation, copilots/assistants) in an enterprise environment.
* Deep understanding of employee lifecycle processes — core HR, recruiting, payroll, time and attendance, compensation, performance, talent, and learning — together with strong SAP SuccessFactors experience, particularly Employee Central and integrated talent modules.
* A track record of running a product discipline for internal or enterprise platforms — managing user stories and backlogs, prioritizing against business value, setting delivery milestones, and reporting adoption and business impact, not just go-live.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cultural and organizational change within a team built around configuring purchased or SaaS applications, moving it toward a modern, product-engineering way of working.
* Strong collaborative leadership, communication, and vendor-management skills, with a track record of aligning HR, technology, and executive stakeholders.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in HR technology or enterprise applications, including significant people-leadership responsibility, with meaningful hands-on or leadership experience in software/application engineering (APIs, microservices, cloud-native development, or AI application delivery).
* Expertise in SAP SuccessFactors and its integration with payroll, benefits, identity, and other enterprise platforms.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI/GenAI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation (Robotic Process Automation (RPA), workflow automation, copilots/assistants) in an enterprise environment.
* Experience leading Agile product delivery (Scrum or Kanban, backlog management, release planning) for enterprise application teams.
* Experience leading build-versus-buy evaluations, vendor selections, and RFPs for enterprise or HR technology.
* Knowledge of cloud architecture, APIs, integration/middleware, identity and access management, and application security.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and audit requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience with applicant tracking (e.g., Greenhouse), workforce management, and integrations with financial planning platforms (e.g., Anaplan) preferred.

**Who We Are**

We’re a team of creators, storytellers, and innovators united under the Hasbro family and home to beloved brands, AAA digital games studios and immersive experiences that spark imagination across generations. Together, we’re committed to a culture rooted in creativity, excellence, curiosity, and inclusion, and where every employee is empowered to think boldly, act with integrity, and spark joy for all.

Wizards of the Coast Who We Are – Wizards of the Coast

Title: Sr Strategy & Programs Manager, Internet Local Marketing Strategy Lead
Description:

The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.
  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.
  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.
  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.
  
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred
* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

Travel required

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Middle East & Africa is seeking an accomplished **Group Procurement Director** to lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive, group-wide strategic procurement function across our portfolio of operating hotels.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a commercially driven professional capable of transforming a decentralized purchasing environment into a coordinated, efficient, and value-generating procurement organization.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of establishing procurement strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and sourcing capabilities across complex organizations comprising multiple operating entities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Procurement Strategy & Organization**

* Design and implement a group-wide procurement strategy, operating model, and governance framework.
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, approval authorities, and compliance standards across the hotel portfolio.
* Define the optimal balance between centralized strategic sourcing and decentralized operational purchasing.

**2. Group Synergies & Value Creation**

* Identify and capture procurement synergies, economies of scale, and consolidation opportunities across multiple properties and geographies.
* Develop category management strategies, group purchasing agreements, and preferred supplier frameworks.
* Deliver measurable cost efficiencies while maintaining operational quality, service standards, and business continuity.

**3. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.
* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and develop regional and international sourcing opportunities.
* Implement robust supplier evaluation, risk management, and contractual governance processes.

**4. Performance, Technology & Transformation**

* Introduce procurement performance indicators, spend analytics, reporting dashboards, and savings measurement methodologies.
* Drive procurement digitalization, including appropriate e-procurement platforms and purchasing systems.
* Build a culture of procurement excellence, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**

* Partner closely with hotel General Managers, Finance Directors, operational teams, and corporate leadership.
* Engage constructively with hotel owners and stakeholders to align procurement initiatives with property-level requirements and ownership structures.
* Build and lead a high-performing procurement organization capable of supporting a geographically diversified portfolio.

**The ideal candidate:**

* 15+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership responsibilities in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and scaling centralized or coordinated procurement functions across large, decentralized, multi-entity organizations.
* Strong experience in category management, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, procurement governance, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to generate measurable financial benefits through procurement consolidation and organizational transformation.
* Experience in hospitality, retail, food & beverage, travel retail, or other multi-site service industries. Hospitality experience is advantageous but not essential.
* Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, analytical capabilities, and technology orientation.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and change-management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across independently managed operating entities.
* Preferably currently based in the UAE or wider GCC, with relevant regional market knowledge and supplier networks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional certifications are advantageous.

**Why join us?**

This position offers the opportunity to **build and shape a strategic procurement function at group level**, with direct influence on operational performance, profitability, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Chief Performance Officer, the Group Procurement Director will play a central role in strengthening the operational excellence and competitiveness of Millennium & Copthorne Hotels across the Middle East and Africa.

We welcome applications from accomplished procurement leaders across industries who have demonstrated the ability to create scalable, high-performing procurement organizations.

**If you have built procurement capabilities across complex, multi-site businesses and are ready to make a tangible impact at regional level, we would welcome your interest.**

Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Location - Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah**

**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

Title: Global Travel Retail Executive
Description:
**Job Description: Global Travel Retail (GTR) Executive**

**Company:** Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI)  
**Department:** Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE – Head Office  
**Reporting to:** Director – Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirements:** Based on business needs.

**Position Overview:**

Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI) is seeking a proactive, commercially driven Travel Retail Executive to support the continued expansion and management of its Global Travel Retail business.

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.
* Act as the main coordination point for account-related inquiries, operational requirements, and commercial follow-ups.
* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.
* Develop and maintain monthly sales dashboards tracking actual performance against forecasts and targets.
* Identify sales trends, underperforming SKUs, and opportunities to improve product assortment and retail performance.
* Monitor retail selling prices, competitive positioning, and relevant market developments across airports.
* Coordinate with retail partners to establish consistent sales reporting schedules and ensure timely receipt of accurate data.
* Prepare monthly account performance reviews with key findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions.

**Planning, Inventory & Order Management:**

* Coordinate with duty-free operators to obtain regular stock reports and monitor inventory levels by SKU and retail location.
* Work closely with GTI's Demand Planning, Production, and Logistics teams to develop rolling sales forecasts and replenishment requirements.
* Proactively identify potential out-of-stock situations and recommend timely replenishment orders.
* Coordinate purchase orders from confirmation through production, shipment, delivery, and receipt.
* Monitor stock coverage, inventory ageing, and slow-moving products, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Maintain visibility over lead times, shipment schedules, and operational constraints affecting product availability.

**New Listings & Business Expansion:**

* Support the onboarding of new duty-free accounts and airport listings with international operators, including Avolta, Heinemann, OSPREE, CREOL, and other partners.
* Coordinate the administrative and operational requirements for new product listings, including SKU documentation, product specifications, pricing submissions, and required commercial information.
* Maintain a central pipeline tracker for upcoming airport listings, launches, and account development projects.
* Coordinate internally with Marketing, Finance, Legal, Production, and Logistics to ensure timely completion of listing requirements.
* Follow up with partners on launch schedules, initial purchase orders, stock delivery, and retail readiness.
* Support the preparation of commercial presentations, account proposals, and business development materials.

**Marketing & Retail Execution:**

* Coordinate with GTI's Marketing team and duty-free operators to implement agreed trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and brand visibility initiatives.
* Monitor the installation and maintenance of branded displays, gondolas, point-of-sale materials (POSM), and other merchandising assets.
* Ensure the agreed product assortment, shelf placement, and brand visibility standards are maintained across retail locations.
* Coordinate promotional calendars, in-store activations, and seasonal commercial initiatives with retail partners.
* Monitor the execution of marketing commitments, including display rentals, promotional placements, and other agreed investments.
* Gather photographic evidence, retail feedback, and execution reports to assess the effectiveness of marketing activities.

**Brand Ambassador & Agency Coordination:**

* Coordinate with appointed Brand Ambassador and merchandising agencies supporting GTI's Travel Retail operations.
* Monitor staffing deployment, attendance, retail coverage, and compliance with agreed service requirements.
* Collect and review Brand Ambassador sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate product training, promotional briefs, and brand-related communication in collaboration with Marketing.
* Track agency performance against agreed KPIs and escalate execution gaps where necessary.
* Support the evaluation of promotional activities and Brand Ambassador effectiveness in driving incremental sales.

**Commercial Administration & Financial Coordination:**

* Maintain accurate records of commercial agreements, pricing structures, listing fees, promotional budgets, and account-specific financial commitments.
* Coordinate with Finance on sales reconciliations, invoicing, payment follow-ups, and outstanding receivables.
* Support monthly reconciliation of consignment sales and inventory for accounts operating under consignment arrangements.
* Validate reported sales quantities, applicable commercial deductions, marketing fees, and settlement amounts against agreed commercial terms.
* Track approved trade marketing expenditure and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Highlight commercial discrepancies, unapproved changes, or potential financial exposure to management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

Performance will be assessed against a combination of commercial, operational, and execution-related indicators:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and growth across assigned Travel Retail accounts.
* **Product Availability:** Stock availability, stock coverage, and reduction of avoidable out-of-stock incidents.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Reliability of sales forecasts and replenishment recommendations.
* **Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission and accuracy of sales, stock, and account performance reports.
* **Listing Execution:** Timely completion of new airport listings, product launches, and associated operational milestones.
* **Retail Execution:** Compliance with agreed assortment, merchandising, display, and promotional requirements.
* **Agency Performance:** Brand Ambassador coverage, reporting compliance, and achievement of agreed performance objectives.
* **Financial Follow-Up:** Timely sales reconciliation, invoicing coordination, and resolution of outstanding payment issues.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, or a related field.

**Professional Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, previous experience in Travel Retail, Duty Free, FMCG, or consumer goods distribution is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with international retail operators, distributors, or multi-market accounts would be an advantage.
* Practical exposure to sales forecasting, inventory management, order processing, and commercial reporting.
* Experience coordinating promotional activities, merchandising programs, or third-party agencies is desirable.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookups, and sales analysis.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and preparation of commercial presentations.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, order management processes, and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI or other business intelligence tools would be an advantage.
* Good understanding of commercial pricing, retail margins, inventory management, and sales performance indicators.

**Core Competencies:**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Ability to interpret sales data, understand retail dynamics, and identify business opportunities.
* **Account Management:** Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build effective relationships with international partners.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Comfortable working with numbers, identifying trends, and translating data into actionable recommendations.
* **Planning & Organization:** Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and concurrent projects.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Effective coordination with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Demand Planning, and Logistics.
* **Problem-Solving:** Proactive approach to resolving operational issues and escalating risks.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multicultural, and expanding international business environment.

Title: Corporate Safety, Insurance and Risk Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

CWS Construction Services is a construction services provider committed to delivering safe, high-quality projects for clients in the region. The company focuses on reliable project execution, strong safety standards, and compliance with industry regulations. Team members work closely across operations, field teams, and leadership to support sustainable growth and consistent service delivery. CWS Construction Services values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement in all aspects of its work.

**Position Summary**

CWS seeks an experienced professional with substantial, hands-on expertise in BOTH industrial construction safety and commercial insurance management. This position leads corporate safety, insurance, claims and risk management programs across CWS operations and project sites. The manager works remotely, with periodic travel to conduct audits, support major projects and investigate significant incidents.

**Role Description**

***Corporate Safety Leadership***

* Develop and maintain corporate safety policies, procedures, training programs and project-specific safety execution plans.

* Oversee compliance with applicable OSHA 1910 and 1926 requirements and customer-specific contractor safety standards.

* Monitor incident trends, TRIR, DART, EMR, corrective actions, training records and contractor prequalification.

* Lead significant incident investigations, root-cause reviews, regulatory coordination and safety improvement initiatives.

* Provide guidance to project managers, superintendents and field safety personnel; retain company-wide stop-work authority.

***Commercial Insurance Management***

* Own administration of workers’ compensation, general liability, commercial auto, umbrella/excess, inland marine/equipment and other applicable coverage.

* Coordinate insurance renewals with brokers and carriers; review coverage limits, exclusions, deductibles, endorsements and premium trends

* Review contractual insurance and indemnity provisions with legal counsel; manage certificates of insurance, additional insured requirements and subcontractor compliance.

* Oversee OCIP/CCIP enrollment and compliance when applicable; coordinate premium, payroll and carrier audits

* Identify coverage gaps, uninsured exposures and opportunities to reduce the company’s total cost of risk.

***Claims and Risk Management***

* Manage workers’ compensation, property, automobile and liability claims in coordination with carriers, adjusters and counsel

* Review loss runs, claim reserves, claims trends and return-to-work opportunities.

* Provide executive leadership with regular reporting on safety performance, claims, insurance costs and material risks.

* Support estimating, business development and project mobilization with safety and insurance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 10 years of combined experience in industrial safety, commercial insurance and risk management.

* At least five years of progressive safety management experience in industrial construction, mechanical contracting or manufacturing.

* At least five years of substantive commercial insurance, claims or corporate risk management experience (may overlap with safety experience).

* Demonstrated responsibility for insurance renewals, policy review, claims and contractual risk transfer—not merely certificate administration.

* Strong knowledge of OSHA 1910/1926, workers’ compensation, construction insurance and multi-state operations.

* Ability to work independently in a remote setting and travel 15–20%.

**Preferred Credentials**

* Bachelor’s degree in safety, insurance, risk management, business or related field, or equivalent experience

* CSP or CHST plus ARM, CRM or CPCU strongly preferred; OSHA 500/501

Bilingual English/Spanish skills are beneficial.

**Work Arrangement and Accountability**

Approximately 80–85% remote, with 15–20% travel for scheduled site audits, project kickoff meetings, customer meetings, in-person training and significant incident response.

Day-to-day field safety execution remains with assigned project managers, superintendents, foremen and onsite safety staff, supported by this corporate role.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fall River, KS 67047

Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

**You'll Be Responsible For:**

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.
